newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Kuala Lumpur tin market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Kuala Lumpur tin market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Kuala Lumpur tin market is closed today for the Christmas holidays. The market reopens on December 26.

On Tuesday, tin price in Malaysia closed 12 cents lower at 14.45 ringgit ($5.72) a kg on initial high offering despite a higher London close. Final turnover was 96 tonnes against 75 on Monday with buying mainly from Malaysia, Europe and Japan.
The local price differential to London was at $90 a tonne premium against $160 previously.
